name: 4-Methylmethamphetamine
summary: 4-Methylmethamphetamine (4-MMA), also known as mephedrine, is a putative stimulant and entactogen drug of the amphetamine family. It acts as a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA). The drug is the β-diketone analogue of mephedrone (4-methylmethcathinone; 4-MMC) and the N-methyl analogue of 4-methylamphetamine (4-MA).

pharmacology.text: 4-MMA acts as a potent and well-balanced serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA). It induces hyperlocomotion and stereotypy (psychostimulant-like effects) as well as hyperthermia in mice, similarly to methcathinone.

uses.en: It is studied in the laboratory as a relative of mephedrone. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它在實驗室中作為喵喵的近親被研究，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它在实验室中作为喵喵的近亲被研究，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. In mice it causes overactivity and overheating, much like mephedrone. Drugs of its class, the substituted amphetamines, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, jaw clenching, insomnia and anxiety, with serious risks of heart problems, psychosis and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。在小鼠身上，它會像喵喵一樣引起過度活躍與體溫過高。與它同類的取代安非他命類藥物可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、咬緊牙關、失眠與焦慮，並有心臟問題、精神病與成癮等嚴重風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。在小鼠身上，它会像喵喵一样引起过度活跃与体温过高。与它同类的取代安非他命类药物可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、咬紧牙关、失眠与焦虑，并有心脏问题、精神病与成瘾等严重风险。

fact.en: Its nickname, mephedrine, reflects that it is mephedrone without the oxygen atom of its ketone group, which turns a cathinone back into an amphetamine.
fact.zh: 它的暱稱「mephedrine」反映出它就是去掉酮基氧原子的喵喵（mephedrone）；少了這個氧，卡西酮就變回了安非他命。
fact.zhHans: 它的暱称「mephedrine」反映出它就是去掉酮基氧原子的喵喵（mephedrone）；少了这个氧，卡西酮就变回了安非他命。
